resources.string: Use at least 8 characters, one number and one symbol. Both passwords must match.
Enter the password used when this file was exported. No account or internet connection is required.

Includes encrypted filters, rules, source URLs, DNS endpoints, retention preferences and unlocked Lava Guards. Endpoint URLs may contain network credentials. Account tokens, purchases, private keys and activity history are excluded. Keep the password safe: Lava cannot recover it. Play and FOSS do not share data automatically. Installing FOSS does not cancel a Play subscription.

Review the settings in this file. You can save the encrypted file for later while offline. Applying it may require source downloads and is subject to this edition’s feature limits. Protection on this device stays as it is. Accounts, purchases, private keys and history are not transferred.
